actions.label: OPEN THE KIT BAG
actions.active: (P) => objId(bo) === 'suit' && !bo.flag('suited') && P.y > L.BOARD.deck - 1 && Math.hypot(P.x - bag.at[0], P.z - bag.at[1]) < 1.5

actions.label: WATCH THE CAMERAS
actions.active: (P) => stageId(bo) === 'inside' && !inside.cine.on && (!inside.dale || inside.dale.dead) && near(P, cx4, cz4, 1.6, L.FL.f1)

actions.label: RELEASE STAIR B
actions.active: (P) => stageId(bo) === 'inside' && !inside.released && !inside.cine.on && (!inside.dale || inside.dale.dead) && near(P, bx4, bz4, 1.5, L.FL.f1)

actions.label: OVERRIDE THE LIFT
actions.active: (P) => stageId(bo) === 'holding' && lift.state === 'locked' && near(P, dx3, dz3, 1.6, L.FLW.f3)

checkpoints.name: 070 The Warden's Floor / The warden's men
07a The Warden's Floor / The lockdown rack

objectives.text: Park behind the billboard and get out: E.

objectives.label: The perch
objectives.text: Climb the service stair to the catwalk.

objectives.label: The thermos
objectives.text: X: the thermos.

objectives.text: X at the west end of the catwalk: ride the contact's line down.

objectives.label: The field
objectives.text: Cross the field to the levee. Crouch in the tall reeds when a light comes.

objectives.label: Control

objectives.label: The operator

objectives.label: The cameras

objectives.label: 2F

objectives.label: 4F
